text:
sarah.m: Hey team — rolling out Private Edge Networking beta for Private/VPC customers today. Includes VPC peering health checks, per-ingress ACLs, and a lightweight edge connector to reduce double-NAT. Opt-in window is open for 2 weeks. Docs: https://redwood.com/docs/private/edge-beta

ben.eng: Quick checklist for customers to opt-in:
- upgrade the operator to `v0.9.1`
- ensure kernel supports IPVS (recommended >= 5.4)
- open ports 443 and 8443 from peered subnets
- run the connectivity test before enabling ACLs

Example commands:
```
rwinfctl edge upgrade --operator v0.9.1
rwinfctl edge check --peer <peer-id>
```

raj.sec: Security notes — default ACL mode is `deny`. Admins must explicitly add ingress rules in the console or via the Edge CRD. This beta also emits audit events to S3-compatible buckets (opt-in via account settings). If you're on a FedRAMP path, file a ticket with #compliance before enabling.

alice.cs: Support playbook updated: /docs/internal/edge-playbook. We'll run two pilot migrations next week with pilot customers (scheduled). I'll post the KB in #support when live.

deploy-bot: Rollout started: canary 5% -> us-east-1 -> operator v0.9.1 (auto-monitoring enabled)

ben.eng: Observability heads-up: new metrics to wire into dashboards: `redwood.edge.conn_success_total`, `redwood.edge.conn_failure_total`, `redwood.edge.kv_cache_hit`. Recommend adding alert for conn_failure_total > 5m.

sarah.m: Timeline: 2-week opt-in period, then we plan to auto-enable for Dedicated customers after 90 days unless they explicitly opt-out. Please review migration checklist and opt-in instructions. Ping me or @raj.sec for security or compliance questions.

lisa: 👍 looking good, will notify partner success for pilot comms

alice.cs: Adding quick triage steps to the KB (connection checks, rollback steps, common errors). Will update thread when done :thumbsup:

raj.sec: k8s compatibility note — we've validated on 1.22 through 1.26. If customers are on older control planes, open an infra ticket and we'll provide a compatibility plan.

ben.eng: Operator rollback command for quick recovery:
```
rwinfctl edge rollback --to v0.8.7
```

sarah.m: Thanks everyone :party_parrot: — tagging @eng-oncall and @customer-success for visibility. Keeping this thread open for feedback and logs from the canary.
